title: Annual Preventive Examination
text:
The annual preventive examination (PRC-110) is covered once per calendar year for adult members and must be billed with a preventive or screening diagnosis in the Z category. The visit should document an age-appropriate history, a physical examination, and any counselling or screening that was ordered.

A preventive examination without acute complaints is expected, and documentation of no acute complaints is normal for this service and does not need additional review. If a significant new problem is addressed and treated, a separate problem-oriented visit should be billed.
